Controls
-- Keyboard
Sprint = Left Shift
Confirm Selection = Spacebar
Quick Cycle = Middle Mouse Button
Target Cycle Left = A
Target Cycle Right = D
Cancel Action = Right Click
Flashstep = Q
Pass = C
Auto = X
Block = V

-- Console
Sprint = Left Joystick (DOWN)
Confirm Selection = A/X
Quick Cycle = Right Joystick (DOWN)

Target Cycle Right = RB/R1
Cancel Action = Right Click
Flashstep/Cancel Action = Left Joystick (DOWN)

Block = B/Circle

games.name: Clover City
games.desc:
Join the group for a permanent glowstick item!

Warning: This game is difficult.

Account must be at least 2 weeks old to play!

💸You can get money by robbing Safes, killing NPCs or getting a job.
💥Most small structures like the streetlights, fire hydrants, and trees can be damaged with any gun or melee.
🪓You can gather wood from the fallen trees and use to barricade certain places
🏠Customize and build your own home
💪Get bigger or smaller at the gym
🕵Explore and discover secrets

Basic Controls:
Hold down to charge your melee attacks.  Max damage when the fist glows.
E, Stomp | G, Carry | Q Mouselock (must have mouselock active)
F, Block | Ctrl, Crouch | Shift, Run

Green bar is your health.  Yellow bar is your stamina.
💫Means you're knocked out, stomping someone knocked out will damage them
⚠️Means you're down, stomping someone down will kill them
☠️Means you're dead

Game similar to Da Hood, Criminality and aspects of Ohio.

games.name: Welcome to Roblox Building
games.desc:
A rewrite of "Welcome to Roblox Building", which was a sandbox building place hosted by Roblox around 2010-2016. 

This remaster of the game features more blocks, more baseplate customization, modernized interfaces, less exploits, save slots, and almost no limit to how much you can build!

This game is still a work in progress! Not all features have been fully polished and implemented yet. If you have any feedback, feel free to send a message to CloneTrooper1019! Thanks!

Special thanks to the team behind the original WTRB:

- Stickmasterluke
- HotThoth
- darthskrill

- jahrblox
- tarabyte
